description: Premasiri Dias Balasuriya v. Padukkage Jayantha Samaratunge Premasiri Dias Balasuriya v. Padukkage Jayantha Samaratunge View More before Hon. Upaly Abeyrathne, J.
parties: Premasiri Dias Balasuriya v. Padukkage Jayantha Samaratunge Premasiri Dias Balasuriya v. Padukkage Jayantha Samaratunge View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the decree entered pursuant to a settlement in a matrimonial action. Held - the petition of appeal had been filed more than 60 days after the decree, contrary to the mandatory requirements of Section 755(3) of the Civil Procedure Code; no explanation for the delay had been given in the petition. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
